exact_evidence_locations: PDF printed p.70: 競技規則第11条 states riders must not engage in runaway/excessive restraint and must race with intent to win and full effort; classified as 不適正走行（敢闘義務違反行為）.
PDF printed p.99: 競技規則第14条第2項斜行・蛇行 section contains 本規定を適用しない基準〔免責事由〕 with unavoidable-interference/avoidance conditions.
PDF printed p.108: 競技規則第70条(4) and current judging criteria explicitly define 周回誤認 disqualification conditions; the same page begins 競技規則第73条 race-non-establishment conditions.
PDF early chapter, printed p.4 area: 計測員 measures 風向、風速、気温等 as a formal judging-operation role.

upgrades.title: 出走表を見る｜競輪ガイド
exact_evidence_locations: Racecard guide defines 脚質 as 逃/両/追.
競走得点 displayed on racecard is described as based on the most recent four months.
決まり手 fields 逃/捲/差/マ are defined as historical 1st/2nd-place methods.
B is final-half-lap back-stretch lead count; H is one-lap-remaining home-stretch lead count; S is count of quickly taking position behind the pacer after the start.
勝率/2連対率/3連対率 and recent results are explicitly described as racecard information.

upgrades.organization: Government ministerial rule hosted by JKA
upgrades.title: 自転車競技法施行規則
exact_evidence_locations: Art.19 enumerates current legal voting-system categories/subtypes.
Art.20 defines winning combinations for single/place, exacta-like, trifecta, quinella-like, wide and trio-like systems.
Art.21 contains explicit tie-ranking handling for wide and three-winner systems.
